decisions.point: duplication output shape — per-cluster verdicts vs the legacy corpus-density summary?
decisions.chose: One EXTRACT_HELPER verdict per Type-2 clone cluster; drop the legacy density-summary line.
decisions.rationale: A clone cluster is independently actionable (extract a shared helper) regardless of corpus-wide density, and the legacy already emitted per-cluster findings unconditionally. The separate density-summary line (gated at 5%) does not map to a per-component verdict in the altitude-driven model; it is a candidate future observation. min_leaf_nodes (10) stays as a noise floor; cluster size is structurally floored at 2 and is NOT a config knob (a min_cluster_size of 1 is meaningless — the call-islands no-dead-knob precedent).
rejected: Density-gate the per-cluster verdicts (only emit if corpus clone fraction > 5%): would silence an egregious clone cluster in a large codebase where overall density is low — clones are actionable regardless of density.
Expose min_cluster_size as a config param: it is a structural floor of 2, so a knob would be dead.

decisions.point: Canonical names for the two rules?
decisions.rationale: Both are structural-shape signals; placing them in the structure.* family (alongside structure.call-islands and structure.escape-hatches) keeps naming coherent, hyphenated leaf per the convention.
rejected: Bare 'god_module'/'duplication' (legacy tag style): inconsistent with the emerging family-dotted v3 convention.
